shortDescription: Resource module for Sda Virtual Network Ip Pool

options.name: autoGenerateVlanName
options.description: It will auto generate vlanName, if vlanName is empty(applicable for L3 and INFRA_VN).

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: ipPoolName
options.description: IpPoolName query parameter.

options.name: isBridgeModeVm
options.description: Bridge Mode Vm enablement flag (applicable for L3 and L2 and default value is False ).

options.name: isCommonPool
options.description: Common Pool enablement flag(applicable for L3 and L2 and default value is False ).

options.name: isIpDirectedBroadcast
options.description: Ip Directed Broadcast enablement flag(applicable for L3 and default value is False ).

options.name: isL2FloodingEnabled
options.description: Layer2 flooding enablement flag(applicable for L3 , L2 and always true for L2 and default value is False ).

options.name: isLayer2Only
options.description: Layer2 Only enablement flag and default value is False.

options.name: isThisCriticalPool
options.description: Critical pool enablement flag(applicable for L3 and default value is False ).

options.name: isWirelessPool
options.description: Wireless Pool enablement flag(applicable for L3 and L2 and default value is False ).

options.name: poolType
options.description: Pool Type (applicable for INFRA_VN).

options.name: scalableGroupName
options.description: Scalable Group Name(applicable for L3).

options.name: siteNameHierarchy
options.description: SiteNameHierarchy query parameter.

options.name: trafficType
options.description: Traffic type(applicable for L3 and L2).

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: virtualNetworkName
options.description: VirtualNetworkName query parameter.

options.name: vlanId
options.description: Vlan Id(applicable for L3 , L2 and INFRA_VN).

options.name: vlanName
options.description: Vlan name represent the segment name, if empty, vlanName would be auto generated by API.
